Taiwan's F-16 Jet Delivery Delayed, Affecting Other Orders

Taiwan's order of 66 F-16 fighter jets, valued at $8 billion, is experiencing delivery delays. The jets are reportedly stuck in Hawaii after a two-week delay. This delay also impacts Morocco's order of 25 advanced jets, which are expected by 2027. The world's largest defense company is facing challenges in fulfilling these orders.
